title: SelectorMap
description: Deterministic element targeting for a single portal workflow. Semantic field names map to CSS selectors. This file is the only shared targeting contract between the portal runner and the healer.

workflow_id.description: Stable identifier for the workflow these selectors belong to.

target_url.description: Absolute URL of the page the selectors are written against.

version.description: Monotonic revision. Increment when any selector in fields changes.

fields.description: Semantic name to CSS selector. Keys are stable field ids consumed by the runner; values are CSS selectors.

additionalProperties.description: A CSS selector that uniquely targets the element for this semantic field.
